title: Privacy
summary: __APP_NAME__ keeps only what it needs to work. Here is what it uses, what it never collects, and how to delete it all.

sections.title: What __APP_NAME__ uses
items: A private ID from Sign in with Apple, so you can sign back in. Never your email.
The username and name you choose.
The notes you write, so they are there on your next visit.
Your time zone, so dates read the way you expect.

sections.title: What __APP_NAME__ never collects
items: Your location, your contacts or your photos.
Anything for ads or tracking. No ads, no analytics, no third-party code that reports on you.
Request logs. The server keeps no record of who asked for what.

sections.title: Who sees what
items: Your notes are yours alone. Nobody else can read them.

sections.title: Deleting
items: Settings, then Delete account, removes your account and everything in it right away. Backups of the database roll past it within 7 days.
